page.layout: One page: centred title "de Ur. E M." and "Idem." at the top, then one column of verse, with the catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: de Ur. E M.
Idem.
main_text.p: QUisque hodie Historiæ numeros implesse putatur; Qui de re quavis dicere plura potest.
Quive adeo fumos aut somnia vendere doctus, Stemmata cujusvis continuare queat;
Fabellasque gravi jacere ac miracula pompà, Quà pueri expaveant, fœmineumque genus.
Paucis culta Fides, paucis reverentia Veri est, Nemo at Mnemosynem demeruisse sitit;
Mnemosynem, monumenta suis quæ sola receptat Illa tholis, Vanum inde exulat, inde Nohtum.
Non tulit id Phœbus, prolesque novena Monetæ, Corque tibi thyrso terque quaterque ferit, UBBO EMMI. hinc Frisicæ surgunt gesta omnia gentis, Ticta Minerva suo quæ velit esse peplo.
Quæque Cupidineæ aurato mucrone sagittæ In tabulis scribat Gratia terna cedri:
Moxque Honor ac Virtus templo deponat avito, Heic aras ubi habet Anna Perenna suas.
Quottidiè quibus Hora rosas, quibus Hebe amaranthos Sufficit; at nectar ambrosiamque Venus.

page.notes: Title "de Ur. E M." read as printed in small capitals; the abbreviation is uncertain. "Nohtum" is printed as shown, with a rule after it. Catchword "Quam" is partly faded and could be read differently. A digitiser credit at the lower right is excluded.
